note: One page per section example: /sections/<company>-<kind>-<n> (669; e.g. /sections/rig-ai-hero-1 = 'Hero section from rig.ai'). No fixed element: tagItem reads the kind out of the slug (69% of children tag), so a company name can never inject an element by itself. The stricter /sections/{name}-{element}-{n} form was rejected: it would drop the ~31% of pages whose kind is not a taxonomy element (about, other, portfolio, contacts…) and it collides every section of one company onto one id. /inspiration/<element> (11) are kind pages that list examples — not examples themselves.
